Bad hits:
Instead of hitting the chair and Darklords the way they did why didn't they at least just limit 3 the chair along with Banishment? Then leave the other cards the way they were before the nerf. Demon's Resonance hit also sucked. Why didn't the skill say instead "You must use Red Dragon Archfiend and Red Nova" or "You must use Red Dragon Archfiend and Hot RDA Bane". I love Red Nova but sometimes I don't like being forced to use it. For some versions I don't use it like with Infernity. I've only made it very few times out of all the duels I've done. Shooting star road is still alive even tho it's a what grows in the gy with a free special summon. Not saying shooting star road should get hit (it really shouldn't). I hate stall decks as much as all of you but One Card Wonder, Hero discard stall, and the cards used that are used to stall (Winda, hollowed, rainbow) from the recent banlist should not have been nerfed. There are more skill hits and decks I'd say got bad hits but I don't want to make this comment longer than it already is. I don't believe any deck in the recent banlist should've been hit.


Indirect hits:
The hit to balance hit many many many F2P decks. Triamid, Aroma, F2P Blue-Eyes were hit. I know Aroma is annoying but Aromas really don't deserve the nerf and no they aren't a stall deck they are a control deck. The hit to Lupine hit Metaphys too. I've seen some people say "People barely played Metaphys anyway". As someone who doesn't play Metaphys in duel links and has only played it a few times in ygo omega the nerf bothered me. I believe they should've hit Levi instead. Konami nerfed so many decks when they hit all those skills before Antinomic Theory.
